fusions.name: Hind-Arm Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks back with the two rearmost arms, dealing 18 damage, knocking the target back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stampede Ring
fusions.desc: Beats every arm against the ground in rhythm, dealing 36 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 50% and your dodge chance by 8% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Drumming Rhythm
fusions.desc: When you strike, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
